Rule Explanation:
Assigns INMONTHMARK across prioritized conditions:
1. Daily Non-EOM Processing: When @PROC_FREQ is 'D' and @PROCESSDATE is not End-of-Month: sets to 'Y' if CUSTOMERCAL.SourceSystemCustomerID matches ACCOUNTCAL.SourceSystemCustomerID; otherwise sets to 'N'.
2. Monthly / EOM Processing: Sets to 'Y' for all records.
Sets COMPLETED to 'Y' when 'ACLRUNNINGPROCESSSTATUS' equals 'Marking_InMonthMark_Customer_Account_level'; otherwise retains existing COMPLETED.
Resets ERRORDATE to NULL when 'ACLRUNNINGPROCESSSTATUS' equals 'Marking_InMonthMark_Customer_Account_level'; otherwise retains existing ERRORDATE.
Resets ERRORDESCRIPTION to NULL when 'ACLRUNNINGPROCESSSTATUS' equals 'Marking_InMonthMark_Customer_Account_level'; otherwise retains existing ERRORDESCRIPTION.
Increments COUNT by 1 when 'ACLRUNNINGPROCESSSTATUS' equals 'Marking_InMonthMark_Customer_Account_level'; otherwise retains existing COUNT.
